desc: Add the pipeline topology and resolver foundation for master planning tasks: optional `RolePairDef.DecompositionRoot` parsed from `decomposition-root`, validation that a decomposition-root role-pair has exactly one outgoing same-subpipeline auto `per-subtask` transition from its approved phase to a specialized role-pair, resolver lookup from specialized role-pair to its decomposition-root role-pair, embedded pipeline updates for the three master role-pairs with quorum 2 states, intra-subpipeline auto-decompose transitions, `us-to-coding` retargeting to `architecture-main-pair`, and Case A `architecture-to-code-plan` bypass to `code-planning-pair`.
done_when: `RolePairDef` has an optional `DecompositionRoot bool` field with YAML tag `decomposition-root,omitempty`; the embedded pipeline and `valid-phase2-full.yaml` contain `epic-planning-main-pair`, `architecture-main-pair`, and `code-planning-main-pair` with `review-policy.quorum: 2`, `provider-diversity: preferred`, `partially-approved` and `reviewing-2` states, and one auto `per-subtask` decompose transition from each main pair approved phase to its specialized pair initial phase; `us-to-coding` targets `architecture-subpipeline.architecture-main-pair.initial`; `architecture-to-code-plan` targets `coding-subpipeline.code-planning-pair.initial` and does not reference `code-planning-main-pair`; validation tests reject decomposition-root configs with zero outgoing decomposition transition, multiple outgoing decomposition transitions, non-auto trigger, non-`per-subtask` cardinality, cross-subpipeline target, or non-approved source phase; resolver tests show `epic-planning-pair`, `architecture-pair`, and `code-planning-pair` map to their respective main pairs while non-specialized pairs return no root; `go test ./internal/pipeline/...` and `liza validate --json` both exit 0.
scope: `internal/pipeline/config.go` and tests for `decomposition-root` schema/validation; `internal/pipeline/resolver.go` and tests for decomposition-root lookup; `internal/embedded/pipeline.yaml` and `internal/pipeline/testdata/valid-phase2-full.yaml` for topology changes; focused pipeline fixture or JSON wiring tests only when needed to prove the embedded pipeline loads. Do not modify initial planning wake templates, master prompt sections, output-entry `DecompositionManifest`, `set-task-output` validation, artifact propagation, docs, or ADR files in this scope.
